round.prompt: 16-bit pixel art, STRICT TOP-DOWN VIEW (perpendicular, no 3/4 angle) viewed from directly above the object. Single isolated rocky asteroid on pure black background. Sharp clean pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, limited palette (max 8 colors), Metal Slug / Star Fox 64 aesthetic. Subject: a single rocky asteroid. Style: ROUND variant — squat potato shape, low eccentricity, lots of craters, the canonical MINE-ASTEROID closed state. Mandatory elements: irregular polygon outline with 12-16 craggy edges (asymmetric, not circle), 2-3 horizontal Greek-key stripe bands (Star Fox 64 angular pattern with right-angle hooks at band ends), 2-4 small craters scattered on the body, 1-2 thin surface cracks, 1-3 small mineral highlights. Brown rocky palette: base brown (140, 100, 60), highlight (180, 140, 90), mid shadow (90, 60, 30), deep shadow (50, 30, 15), black crack (20, 10, 5), mineral highlight (210, 170, 110). MINE-ASTEROID reference style: the asteroid looks like a closed MINE-ASTEROID with the gun hidden inside, ready to split open.
